title: User researcher
description: Confira esta oportunidade para User researcher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Title: Senior User Researcher Location: Brazil (Remote) Employment Type: Contract We're looking for a driven and inspiring Senior User Researcher to join our global team, to help businesses shape their strategy and bring to life products that win people's hearts. You will have a chance to work across diverse industries and product lifecycles, partnering with some of the world's most recognisable brands. Bringing an experimental yet rigorous mindset, you will define the unknowns, challenge assumptions, and collaborate with stakeholders at every level to disrupt markets with new products or transform existing experiences, through customer-driven evidence. Responsibilities: Own user research stream on the project: from spotting opportunities through planning, user recruitment and execution, to helping the team prioritise and embed insight into the product. Set up and manage user research process throughout discovery and delivery of a project, ensuring it fits seamlessly within agile workflows. Conduct various types of research, depending on the context: exploratory, assessment, evaluative, quantitative and qualitative. Collaborate with the design and product team to action the insights and embed them into strategy, roadmap and solutions. Participate in enhancing the practice with the wider user research team: contribute to guidelines, knowledge sharings, supporting people who do research. Consult presale teams on user research approaches for potential new projects, if needed. Required skills and experience: Well-versed in core user research methods and able to execute them independently; this is the minimum expectation for the role before we look at advanced skills. An experimental mindset combined with rigour: you are comfortable trying new tools and approaches, while knowing the true value of user research and guardrails. Proven experience assessing and validating early product concepts with various methods, not only interviews. Skilled in defining customer segmentation across various markets. Experience with recruiting participants for research. A star facilitator, known for leading workshops, design sprints, and co-creation sessions that spark creativity and build alignment. Strong sense of ownership and the drive to move work forward without waiting to be asked. You thrive on minimal direction: we'll support you, but we want you to be the one moving things forward. Stellar communication: advising, negotiating, and effectively collaborating with stakeholders at all levels. Able to connect the dots and create compelling, evidence-led narratives that impact the way stakeholders think, build empathy for customers and guide product decisions. Strong at managing priorities and deadlines: ready to stay organised and adaptable when things get busy or change direction. Well-versed in tools that streamline research: Maze, Dovetail or similar tools for synthesis, repositories, unmoderated testing etc. 5+ years of hands-on experience in a standalone user research role. Nice to have: Experience in Healthcare and/or Banking Data analytics experience Design experience Experience in pre-sale activities What's in it for you? The projects are various, which gives you a lot of new experiences and challenges. We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries. Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate Work on projects for big global brands Exposure to different geographies Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience. Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices. Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

title: Business analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Our purpose eco Portal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team's potential. Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we're committed to helping clients achieve that. Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all. Who are we? We're a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it. We're anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team. Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole. You can see more about our storyjourney here!
We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures. Safety isn't just a department, it's a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. eco Portal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use. We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance. The Role An exciting opportunity is available at eco Portal. We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance Saa S platform. You'll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with eco Portal's product capabilities and delivery standards. As a Business Analyst , you'll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with eco Portal platform capabilities. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of eco Portal's platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies. We're Looking for Someone Who... Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within Saa S or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the "what" and the "why." Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable. Perks & Benefits: 37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. Generous Annual Leave Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with eco Portal. End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at eco Portal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you've been with e P, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you're here. ️ Professional Development: eco Portal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. Wellness Support: To support your mental health and overall wellbeing, we offer reimbursements for professional mental health assistance. Workplace Enjoyment: We believe in fostering a positive, engaged, and diverse team through various social activities. Enjoy virtual social events and company-wide activations with the eco Portal HQ team in NZ and our global offshore team. What now? Ready to introduce yourself? Don't be shy! We want to hear from you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, and any other information, documents and links that will help you stand out. Find out more about eco Portal visit. eco Portal is an equal opportunity employer.

Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

description: Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. 1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system. 2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal. 3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces s. 4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci es. 5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir ies. 6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

title: Senior procurement specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior procurement specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview
This is not a traditional purchasing role. We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry. The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as: Architectural Glass & Glazing Curtain Wall Systems Metal Fabrication ACM & Metal Panel Systems Building Envelope Products Insulation Systems Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products This individual will play a direct role in improving project profitability, strengthening supplier partnerships, and creating scalable procurement processes to support Longarone's next phase of growth.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy. Negotiate national and international supplier agreements. Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors. Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization. Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning. Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities. Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations. Manage procurement forecasting and material planning. Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls. Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules. Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.
Desired Background Required
7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience. Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries. Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience. Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings. Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance. Fluent English communication skills.
Highly Preferred
Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors. Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects. Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies. Experience with ERP and procurement management software.
Success Metrics
Procurement Savings Cost Avoidance Supplier Reliability Lead Time Reduction Margin Improvement Forecast Accuracy Supply Chain Stability
Compensation Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through: Supplier negotiations Strategic sourcing Cost reductions Supply chain improvements Margin enhancement initiatives Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.
Why Join Longarone?
Fully Remote Position Direct Access to Executive Leadership High Growth Environment Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department Performance-Based Compensation Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U. S.

We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries. - Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate - Work on projects for big global brands - Exposure to different geographies - Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners - Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience. - Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices. - Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.
Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.
Responsabilidades:

Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

partnership

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

description:

Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.
About the Role
We’re hiring a
Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.
What You'll Do
Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve
as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships
with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process
by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring
process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.
What We’re Looking For
At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.


2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

Redação e controle de contratos modelo e demandas contratuais diversas. Suporte em processos de regularização imobiliária e incorporação. Auxílio no monitoramento de carteira de litígios (Cível, Consumidor e Trabalhista). Apoio em demandas de Compliance, LGPD e implementação de políticas internas. Residir em Salvador ou RMS. Estar cursando a partir do 5º semestre de Direito. Conhecimentos básicos de informática. Diferencial: conhecimento intermediário em espanhol (será valorizado devido à interface com a matriz). Perfil proativo e com autonomia.

Alguns dos nossos benefícios: Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável. Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial, ampliar seus conhecimentos e construir uma trajetória de crescimento e desenvolvimento de carreira. Somos uma empresa de soluções logísticas integradas, com quase 60 anos de trajetória, integrante do Grupo Ultra e líder entre as empresas independentes de armazenagem de granéis líquidos no país. Nossa atuação é essencial para cadeias produtivas relevantes, com movimentação e armazenagem de combustíveis, biocombustíveis, químicos, petroquímicos e óleos vegetais. Com presença em regiões estratégicas e uma agenda de crescimento conectada às demandas de infraestrutura, energia, abastecimento e desenvolvimento nacional, buscamos lideranças capazes de impulsionar resultados com responsabilidade, visão sistêmica e compromisso com as pessoas. Nosso propósito é movimentar o melhor de cada um para conectar cada vez mais a logística do Brasil. Operações
tem papel estratégico na execução da agenda de crescimento, eficiência e transformação da Ultracargo.

Responsável pelo Terminal de Aratu, Bahia e pelo planejamento, gestão e controle da operação do terminal, bem como pela gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe de colaboradores de Operações, Administrativo, SSMA e Manutenção visando atingir metas e objetivos determinados na estratégia da empresa e obedecendo a legislação, orçamento e processos de melhoria contínua. Conhecimentos: Habilidade em gestão e capacitação de pessoas. Conhecimento de operações de terminais e logística. Capacitação em processo e gestão de recursos.
Área de Formação: Engenharia ou outra formação técnica Pós graduação em áreas correlatas
Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que conecta pessoas, negócios e regiões do Brasil com segurança, responsabilidade e visão de futuro, essa oportunidade pode ser para você. Venha movimentar o melhor de você com a Ultracargo.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

title: Senior solution architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior solution architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role
Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a
Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.
In This Role, You Will Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.
What You’ve Accomplished So Far 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB or other No SQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
How You’ll Ramp Up By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Mentor junior team members.

ii

title: Lead product designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead product designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.
Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.
About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.
You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.
Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.
Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.
Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

ii

title: Sales analyst

Legislação de transporte rodoviário de cargas e normas de segurança para peças automotivas. Sistemas TMS, rastreamento em tempo real e indicadores de nível de serviço (SLA). Excel intermediário/avançado para análises operacionais e dashboards. title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.
